timeline.text: The Town of Timnath was incorporated on June 29.
The last class graduated from Timnath High School, and the Timnath Consolidated School District voted on July 1 to merge with other schools.
Voters made Timnath a home rule municipality on November 7.

trails.name: Fossil Creek Reservoir Natural Area
trails.manager: City of Fort Collins Natural Areas, with Larimer County
trails.size: About 1,400 acres of prairie, wetland and reservoir, an Audubon Important Bird Area, with three short trails to picnic shelters and viewing areas
trails.address: 3340 Carpenter Road, Fort Collins, at the Fossil Creek Reservoir Trailhead (restrooms and water)
trails.season: Open daily, dawn to dusk, with seasonal closures to protect eagle roosts.
trails.dogs: Not allowed: hiking only, with no dogs, bikes or horses.
